odometer_decreased.title: The odometer of {car} went down
odometer_decreased.description: The odometer sensor of {car} reported {value} {unit} 2 times, below the last reading of {current} {unit}. Car Keeper keeps the last reading. If the sensor is wrong, fix the sensor. If the car has a new instrument cluster, correct the odometer of the car and set an offset.
